title: lonicera glehnii var. viridissima
intro: Lonicera glehnii var. viridissima, commonly known as the green Honeysuckle or Japanese Honeysuckle, is a plant species in the family Caprifoliaceae. It is used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Lonicera glehnii var. viridissima include pain relief, fever reduction, and treatment of respiratory issues such as coughs and bronchitis. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
